# Executive Summary: Two-Way SMS Reminder Test

**For:** Director of Ambulatory Access (simulated 24-clinic outpatient network)
**Data:** synthetic, generated by `src/generate_data.py` (seed 42). All figures describe a simulated network.

## Recommendation: roll out network-wide

The test met the rule we wrote down before it started. Unfilled slots fell, the 95% confidence interval excludes zero, and estimated net value stays positive at the low end of its range.

## What happened (17 weeks, 2025-03-03 to 2025-06-29, about 24,759 slot appointments per arm)

| | One-way SMS (today) | Two-way SMS | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| No-show rate | 13.8% | 11.1% | -2.62 pp (-19% relative) |
| Late cancellations (< 24 h) | 6.2% | 7.7% | +1.46 pp |
| Late-cancelled slots refilled | 24% | 59% | +35.1 pp |
| **Slots left empty** | **18.5%** | **14.2%** | **-4.20 pp** |

- **Late cancellations went up, and that is the intended effect.** Patients who used to no-show now cancel a day or more ahead, and the clinic can refill the slot. The empty-slot rate is the number that tracks revenue and access.
- **Medicaid patients benefit most** (-5.6 pp on no-shows). Commercial patients still benefit (-1.5 pp).

## Value (simulated economics)

| Option | Slots recovered per year | Net value per year (95% range) |
|---|---|---|
| Network-wide | 6,412 | $1,002K ($848K to $1,157K) |
| Medicaid + self-pay only | 3,076 | $473K ($375K to $570K) |

Assumptions: $0.04 per text, $18,000 per year platform fee, $160 margin per filled slot. Network-wide costs $24K per year and adds about $530K more than the targeted option. The margin is an upper bound if a clinic has no waitlist to refill from.

## One data problem we caught

One clinic (C17) lost its treatment-group records from 2025-04-07 to 2025-04-15 because of a logging outage. The overall 50/50 check did not show it. A clinic-by-week check did, and the text-message log confirmed it. We removed that clinic-window from both groups before computing results.

## Next steps

1. Proceed (roll out network-wide). Keep a 5% holdout for one quarter to confirm the effect holds.
2. Add the empty-slot rate to the access scorecard next to the no-show rate.
3. Add an automatic per-clinic daily check to the experiment platform.
